# 📦 Dependency Security Review

## Package change
- Package:
- From version:
- To version:
- Direct/transitive:

## Supply-chain review
- [ ] Registry and package identity checked
- [ ] Maintainer and release activity reviewed
- [ ] License checked
- [ ] Install scripts considered
- [ ] Transitive dependency impact reviewed
- [ ] Lockfile diff inspected

## Security signals
Advisories, CVEs, affected ranges, exploitability, and mitigation.

## Compatibility
Node/npm support, Vite/React peer ranges, build and bundle impact.

## Verification
- [ ] npm ci
- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm test
- [ ] npm run build

## Decision
Approve / Hold / Reject, owner, and evidence.
